a.xlink:title: --- stage: build script: - echo "Building application version $BUILD_VERSION" - mkdir -p build/bin - echo "app-binary-content" > build/bin/app - echo "Version $BUILD_VERSION built at $(date)" > build/version.txt artifacts: paths: - build/ expire_in: 1 week name: app-build-$CI_COMMIT_REF_SLUG

--- stage: test dependencies: - build:app script: - echo "Running unit tests with $(cat build/version.txt)" - mkdir -p test-results - | cat > test-results/junit.xml << EOF <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <testsuites> <testsuite name="UnitTests" tests="5" failures="0" errors="0"> <testcase name="test_login" time="0.5"/> <testcase name="test_logout" time="0.3"/> <testcase name="test_validation" time="0.7"/> <testcase name="test_api" time="1.2"/> <testcase name="test_database" time="0.8"/> </testsuite> </testsuites> EOF artifacts: reports: junit: test-results/junit.xml paths: - test-results/ expire_in: 30 days

--- stage: test dependencies: - build:app script: - echo "Generating coverage report" - mkdir -p coverage - | cat > coverage/cobertura.xml << EOF <?xml version="1.0"?> <coverage line-rate="0.85" branch-rate="0.80" version="1.0"> <packages> <package name="main" line-rate="0.85" branch-rate="0.80"> <classes> <class name="App" line-rate="0.90" branch-rate="0.85"/> </classes> </package> </packages> </coverage> EOF - echo "Total coverage: 85%" > coverage/summary.txt artifacts: reports: coverage_report: coverage_format: cobertura path: coverage/cobertura.xml paths: - coverage/ expire_in: 1 month

--- stage: test dependencies: - build:app - build:assets script: - echo "Running integration tests" - ls -la build/ dist/ - mkdir -p integration-logs - echo "Integration test log - $(date)" > integration-logs/test.log - echo "All integration tests passed" > integration-logs/status.txt artifacts: paths: - integration-logs/ expire_in: 1 week when: always

--- stage: test dependencies: - build:app script: - echo "Running debug tests" - mkdir -p debug-logs - echo "Debug output: $(date)" > debug-logs/debug.log - echo "Memory usage: 128MB" > debug-logs/memory.log artifacts: paths: - debug-logs/ expire_in: 3 days when: on_failure name: debug-logs-$CI_JOB_ID

--- stage: report dependencies: - test:unit - test:coverage - test:integration script: - echo "Generating test summary report" - echo "=== Test Summary ===" > summary.txt - echo "Unit Tests:" >> summary.txt - cat test-results/junit.xml | grep 'testsuite' >> summary.txt || true - echo "" >> summary.txt - echo "Coverage:" >> summary.txt - cat coverage/summary.txt >> summary.txt - echo "" >> summary.txt - echo "Integration:" >> summary.txt - cat integration-logs/status.txt >> summary.txt - cat summary.txt artifacts: paths: - summary.txt expire_in: 90 days name: test-summary-$CI_PIPELINE_ID

--- stage: deploy dependencies: - build:app - build:assets script: - echo "Deploying to staging" - echo "Application binary: $(cat build/bin/app)" - echo "CSS files: $(ls dist/css/)" - echo "JS files: $(ls dist/js/)" - echo "Deployed version: $(cat build/version.txt)" environment: name: staging artifacts: paths: - build/version.txt expire_in: 6 months name: deployment-info

--- stage: deploy dependencies: [] script: - echo "Deploying documentation" - mkdir -p docs - echo "# API Documentation" > docs/README.md - echo "Version: $BUILD_VERSION" >> docs/README.md artifacts: paths: - docs/ expire_in: never

--- stage: build script: - echo "Compiling assets" - mkdir -p dist/css dist/js - echo "body { color: blue; }" > dist/css/style.css - echo "console.log('hello');" > dist/js/app.js artifacts: paths: - dist/ expire_in: 2 days name: assets-$CI_JOB_NAME-$CI_COMMIT_SHORT_SHA

--- stage: build script: - echo "Creating package" - mkdir -p package/src package/test - echo "source code" > package/src/main.rb - echo "test code" > package/test/main_test.rb - echo "secret" > package/secret.key artifacts: paths: - package/ exclude: - package/**/*.key expire_in: 2 weeks name: package-$CI_COMMIT_TAG
